title: Grain API
snippet:
Grain supports three authentication methods depending on your use case.
**Personal Access Token (PAT)**: grants access on behalf of a single user. The token has the same permissions as the user who generated it. Best for personal automations or testing. Available on every plan, including Free. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/account/integrations/personal_api) to generate a PAT.
**Workspace Access Token (WAT)**: grants access to all data in the workspace, regardless of which user owns it. Use this for server-side integrations where you need workspace-wide access. Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api) to generate a WAT.
**OAuth2**: the standard flow for building integrations to be used by any Grain user. Users authorize your application directly, and your app receives a token scoped to that user's data. Required if you are building an integration to distribute to others.

**Do I need a specific Grain plan to use the API?** Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.

title: Introduction
snippet:
MCP access is included on Growth and Scale. Organization API keys and unmanaged OAuth require an active Scale subscription. Grain-managed Live OAuth apps with an active grant may call `/api/v1` on Starter and Growth.

Rate limits
| Scope | Limit |
|---|---|
| Standard | 100 requests per minute per organization |
| Burst | Short bursts above the limit may return `429 Too Many Requests` |
Rate limit headers are included on responses:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 87
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000060
```
Contact [Grain Support](https://grainledger.com/support) for higher limits on enterprise integrations.

title: Grain API: Export Your Meeting Transcripts
snippet:
Grain uses Bearer Token (OAuth) authentication. Generate an API token from your Grain workspace settings and pass it in the Authorization header on every request.
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_grain_api_token>
Content-Type: application/json
```
API access requires a **Business plan**($29/seat/month). Free and Pro plans do not include API access. Contact your Grain workspace admin to provision credentials if you don't have them.

Business plan required for API access
Grain's Public API is only available on the Business plan at $29/seat/month. Teams on Free or Pro plans cannot access the API, which limits automation options to manual exports or native integrations only.

**API improvements**
We've made big improvements to our API and its documentation. A few highlights:
- Much more reliable uploads for audio, video, or transcripts only
- Metadata you can edit through the API
- Access and sharing controls at upload
- Much easier querying
